description: Publish a landing page, making it publicly accessible at its URL. For a page whose distribution is 'self_hosted' (set_landing_page_distribution), this makes the page's content available at the public API — the customer's own renderer, not PostKing/universal-lp, serves the actual public URL. See set_landing_page_distribution for the self-hosted setup (optional example: https://github.com/bitsandtea/postking-selfhost).
name: publish_landing_page
